$comment: Hand-override registry for token logos. Keys are 'chain:address' (address lowercased) or 'symbol:SYMBOL' for chain-agnostic overrides. Values are public URLs or workspace-relative paths under /public. resolveTokenLogo() checks this map first, then cascades DexScreener, TrustWallet, CoinGecko. Use this to ship $WAIFU's logo the moment it mints, or to override an auto-resolved icon, or to give symbol-only assets (hyperliquid perps have no contract) a real mark. Perp marks live under /token-logos and are crisp brand vectors: btc/eth/sol/bnb/zec/usdc from the cryptocurrency-icons CC0 set, near from web3icons, hype from hyperliquid's own coin svg.
